figmaParityCheck.note: Since the Figma rebuild (a single Button component set with Type x State variants, 18 combinations), figma-cli check covers all 6 types (Primary/Outline/Secondary/Ghost/Destructive/Link) x 3 states exhaustively. Only type: primary (formerly default) uses real token bindings (fills: background.primary, typography: font-sm/md/lg); all other types use neutral styles from index.css.

base.note: Applies to all variants and sizes, not repeated per variant/size.

radius.note: Not referenced directly in button.tsx, but bound via Tailwind utility classes (rounded-md/sm/xs) and index.css.

variants.name: primary
variants.note: Primary fill and text rely on shadcns --primary / --primary-foreground mapped in index.css to brand.copper / background.base.

variants.name: destructive
variants.note: Background (bg-destructive/10, hover:bg-destructive/20) uses shadcn native --destructive. Text uses custom token color.text.destructive.default.

variants.name: link
variants.note: Uses text-primary, matching the primary variant token.

sizes.name: xs
sizes.note: --radius-md here is the shadcn-derived variable calc(var(--radius) * 0.8).

sizes.name: lg
sizes.note: Kein Size-eigener Radius-Override, erbt den Basis-rounded-lg (siehe base.radius).

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with variant/size classes via cn(), overrides classes upon collision.

passthrough.note: All additional props are passed unchanged to ButtonPrimitive (Base UI / Radix primitive).
